economy.zh:
今日经济新闻围绕三大主线展开：AI产业出现转折性信号——企业开始意识到AI无法完全替代人类，出现裁员后重新招聘的‘后悔潮’；能源市场在伊朗停火后原油供应激增与卡塔尔LNG中断形成多空拉锯；中美欧贸易博弈升温，欧盟给中国设10月截止日要求解决贸易逆差。全球股市分化，美股AI交易从巨头转向供应商，中国A股受PMI和领导人讲话提振上扬。

- **AI裁员后悔潮蔓延**：多家公司发现AI不能胜任所有工作，开始重新招聘人类员工，福特甚至召回退休‘灰胡子’工程师。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/01/employers-who-laid-off-workers-for-ai-are-reversing-their-decisions.html) [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/jun/30/ai-backfired-so-ford-had-to-rehire-humans-greybeard-engineers)
- **Anthropic出口管制解除**：美国商务部取消对Anthropic Fable 5和Mythos 5模型的出口禁令，此前因黑客风险暂停。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/30/anthropic-says-trump-admin-has-lifted-export-controls-on-claude-fable-5-and-mythos-5.html) [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdr42623e1do)
- **伊朗原油恢复出口**：停火后霍尔木兹海峡交通恢复，伊朗以20%溢价出口4000万桶原油。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/01/iran-us-mou-negotiation-war-oil-exports-strait-of-hormuz-.html)
- **卡塔尔LNG供应收缩**：卡塔尔能源将不可抗力延长至9月，再扣押4批意大利LNG货物。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/01/qatarenergy-extend-force-majeure-september-italys-edison-iran-war-.html)
- **日本干预汇市74亿美元**：但分析师认为只要美日利差持续，干预效果有限。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/01/japan-yen-40-year-low-intervention-fed-boj-carry-trade.html)
- **特朗普加密收入超5.8亿美元**：其927页财务披露显示加密货币收入远超房地产。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/30/trump-financial-disclosure-released.html) [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgmv98ez3zo)
- **中国6月PMI强劲 + 习近平讲话**：A股上证涨1.08%，大金融和化工板块领涨。[Business Times](https://news.google.) [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFAyeUswc2x4RVVveFV1NUs4N1FwVXpLUFNZRGhZRk93SnpYTU02el9Nd3p3UXh5M1ZVWWZRWFZObDhCSjhydU5hM19Fd2xNWklXTlVpRUdlU1RKb2FYQ3c)
- **欧盟要求中国10月前解决贸易逆差**：中欧贸易紧张升级，欧洲担忧去工业化。[SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/plus/news/china/diplomacy/article/3358895/eu-seeks-tangible-results-china-trade-deficit-october) [Al Jazeera](https://news.google.)

**后续观察**：AI从‘替代人类’到‘人机协作’的叙事转变可能重塑科技投资逻辑；能源市场需关注伊朗供应恢复与卡塔尔中断的平衡，以及美国财长对油企的压价警告；中欧贸易谈判在10月前将持续扰动市场情绪，电动车和新能源行业首当其冲。
economy.en:
Markets opened the second half of 2026 with a clear tech-led bid, tempered by geopolitical cross-currents and diverging central bank signals. Japan’s record ¥11.5 trillion ($74B) yen intervention failed to reverse losses as U.S.-Japan rate differentials remain the dominant driver, highlighting the limits of unilateral FX action. AI trade rotation continues: Jim Cramer notes Wall Street now favors infrastructure suppliers over the hyperscalers funding the boom, while Anthropic’s export ban lift on Fable 5/Mythos 5 opens new front in semiconductor competition. Energy markets are in flux – Iran’s post-ceasefire oil exports surge at a 20% premium while QatarEnergy extends force majeure on LNG cargoes into September, keeping European gas prices volatile. China’s June factory activity data beat forecasts, lifting Shanghai stocks and reinforcing Xi’s reaffirmation of growth targets. The EU has set an October deadline for “tangible results” on its trade deficit with China, raising the stakes for EV and battery tariffs. On the corporate front, Nike beat estimates but China sales fell 12%, adding to concerns about consumer demand in the world’s second-largest economy. Meanwhile, the first batch of semi-annual financial disclosures shows Trump earned $580M+ from crypto, underscoring the political economy of digital assets. 

- **[Japan spent $74 billion propping up the yen. Investors say the real battle is with the Fed](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/01/japan-yen-40-year-low-intervention-fed-boj-carry-trade.html)** – FX intervention alone insufficient; market eyes Fed path. 
- **[Anthropic says Trump admin has lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/30/anthropic-says-trump-admin-has-lifted-export-controls-on-claude-fable-5-and-mythos-5.html)** – Export ban reversal opens competition in advanced AI models. 
- **[Jim Cramer says the AI trade has shifted — and these stocks are leading now](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/30/jim-cramer-ai-trade-shifted-stocks-leading-now.html)** – Market rewards AI infrastructure plays rather than big tech spenders. 
- **[Iran says it is selling oil at 20% premium as end of U.S. blockade sees 40 million barrels exported](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/01/iran-us-mou-negotiation-war-oil-exports-strait-of-hormuz-.html)** – Ceasefire unlocks oil flows but premiums reflect lingering risk. 
- **[LNG market disruption may continue for months as a top producer withholds some Italian shipments](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/01/qatarenergy-extend-force-majeure-september-italys-edison-iran-war-.html)** – QatarEnergy extends force majeure on LNG cargoes until September, tightening European supply. 
- **[China stocks rise on robust factory activity data, Xi’s speech](https://news.google.)** – June Caixin PMI beat expectations, Xi reinforces economic stability message. 
- **[EU seeks ‘tangible results’ on China trade deficit by October](https://www.scmp.com/plus/news/china/diplomacy/article/3358895/eu-seeks-tangible-results-china-trade-deficit-october)** – Trade negotiations face hard deadline; EV tariffs likely on the table. 

**Watch next:** Friday’s U.S. nonfarm payrolls will test the Fed’s resolve against a backdrop of yen intervention fatigue. The rotation within AI (from hyperscalers to suppliers) could accelerate if semiconductor earnings confirm demand. On the macro side, the EU-China trade talks and Qatar’s LNG standoff will be key for energy and industrial stocks. The beat in China factory data may offer a short-term boost to materials and industrials, but the drag from weak property and car sales remains a headwind.

society.zh:
今日社会新闻板块呈现多重震荡：美国最高法院在任期最后一天同时打出“左拳”与“右勾拳”，既维护出生公民权又允许限制跨性别运动员；委内瑞拉强震后奇迹救出3岁儿童，但该国本就脆弱的治理体系面临重建难题；巴基斯坦一处补习中心屋顶坍塌导致14名儿童死亡，暴露出南亚地区建筑安全顽疾。此外，一架飞机撞入北京某大楼，中国官方却选择沉默，引发外界对信息透明度的关注。日元跌至40年新低，日本民众即将面临超过2500种食品涨价。与此同时，中国庆祝建党105周年，习近平发表重要讲话，强调“时间不等人”。知乎社区则围绕TFBOYS“合体”与AI毕业展掀起怀旧与未来碰撞的讨论。

- **美国两极化司法**：最高法在 [出生公民权](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cgmepnx1wzzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 上与特朗普彻底决裂，却又在 [跨性别运动员禁令](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj40x888d9go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 上向保守派让步——一个任期塑造了“既有重创又有扩张”的矛盾遗产。
- **委内瑞拉幸存奇迹**：地震后六天，一名3岁男童被 [从废墟中救出](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1jykwk8n18o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，但《卫报》 [深度报道](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jul/01/wednesday-briefing-after-two-powerful-earthquakes-what-is-the-reality-on-the-ground-in-venezuela) 指出，国家几乎无救灾能力，国际援助或成唯一依靠。
- **巴基斯坦教室之殇**：拉合尔郊区 [屋顶垮塌](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr7x38lle1jo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 致14名儿童丧生，两人被拘，安全标准缺失再次刺痛社会神经。
- **北京撞击事件成谜**：一架飞机撞上北京某大楼，但 [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crlwe28dz44o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) 称中方清理痕迹不解释，信息黑箱令人担忧。
- **日元失控与物价飙升**：日元兑美元 [跌至162](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/.../yen-40-year-low/)，同日日本宣布 [2566种食品7月涨价](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/.../price-hikes-july/)，生活成本危机加剧。
- **建党105周年**：习近平在 [讲话](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQTEN4OElSbnFFSmVvQkZHdEVWMzVsX28yMnRYSE9zZFBrTVNFLXdweUl5TG5aLVUySTR6em1JTEpMeVd2WWJFa1R6eHUyQUd2Y0FfNVJPRng5dmI5dlRMTUl3MFBZNXM2V3RteEhjb3BDWWUwWnJWWDB3azVNUHl6bThLZUQxS081RFJ2T2Q3YU9weXhOR0E) 中重申“使命未竟”，国务院同日印发 [《教育发展“十五五”规划》](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE9QNTU2Y2ZBbWkxRzB4ZXpGRnRucHZod3ZBaFg5UUtucjRnOW43RXkwWjZJaHRhdVZhU1FXb0piNHNUOW14dzJCTg)，政策信号密集。

**后续观察**：美国最高法判决将激化大选年移民与性别议题的舆论战；委内瑞拉救灾考验国际协调机制；巴基斯坦事故可能引发对私立教育机构安全排查；日元若持续贬值，东亚货币战风险上升。中国教育规划细则如何落地，以及北京撞击事件后续信息披露，值得持续跟踪。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a split-screen reality: the U.S. Supreme Court delivered blockbuster rulings on birthright citizenship and transgender athlete bans, while a mysterious plane crash in Beijing remains shrouded in state silence. Geopolitical tremors continue from the Afghanistan-Pakistan border to Venezuela's earthquake zone, and economic shockwaves from the yen's 40-year low ripple across Asia. Here are the developments that matter most.

- **U.S. Supreme Court rules on birthright citizenship and transgender sports**: In a major setback for Trump, the court upheld birthright citizenship, while simultaneously upholding bans on transgender athletes in female school sports. The dual rulings underscore a divided judiciary on social issues. [Source](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cgmepnx1wzzo)
- **Mysterious plane crash in Beijing**: A plane struck a tower in Beijing, but Chinese authorities have scrubbed visible traces and offered no explanation, raising serious transparency concerns. [Source](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crlwe28dz44o)
- **Afghan Taliban escalate border strikes on Pakistan**: Pakistan shot down four drones and vowed a response, as tensions surge along the Durand Line. [Source](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c621g086ek4o)
- **China emerges as clear winner from Trump’s Middle East war**: A new report by Asia Group concludes that China weathered the Hormuz crisis and is now reaping gains from the global push for solar and EVs. [Source](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/30/china-clear-winner-trump-war-middle-east-report-iran-strait-of-hormuz)
- **Venezuela earthquake rescue**: A three-year-old was pulled from rubble six days after the quake, as the country struggles to rebuild with minimal state presence. [Source](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1jykwk8n18o)
- **Pakistan tuition centre roof collapse kills 14 children**: Two people have been taken into custody in Lahore after the tragic incident. [Source](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr7x38lle1jo)
- **Japan’s yen hits 40-year low, pressuring South Korea**: The yen broke the ¥162 level against the dollar, exacerbating FX tensions in East Asia and raising import costs. [Source](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/06/30/yen-40-year-low-162-level/)

**Watch next**: The fallout from the Supreme Court's birthright ruling will shape Trump's immigration agenda in the final stretch of his term. Meanwhile, China's silence on the Beijing plane crash and its celebration of the CPC's 105th anniversary may signal a continued clampdown on information. Keep an eye on further yen depreciation and its snowball effect on Korean won and regional trade.

military.zh:
今日军事板块的核心信号是“大国博弈的技术化与实战化演练加速”。北约、美国及其盟友在环太平洋、土耳其、波罗的海等多地同步展开大规模军演，其中沉船演习（RIMPAC）与“鹰击”系列实弹射击尤为引人注目，直指反舰作战能力验证。同时，[B-2隐形轰炸机首次发射LRASM远程反舰导弹](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxOeDN0RDlUOEJ4Y3RGb0ladXJRRDdKYTZtOG84TnV5blFkUUVwc0lLM0FtV2lkcGRReC1TLUE5dzhEZjVoR0ptd0JhYWFpYjdaWnVzVmZ5SGtrSTEtUDI4cmVoLVRfRmlEMVEtUkdPLUh1SXBaQk00cEdSLVNNT3dNTzYxU0w)和[中国卡车式电磁弹射器首次公开](https://www.twz.com/news-features/chinas-truck-mounted-electromagnetic-aircraft-catapult-seen-in-action-for-the-first-time)形成中美技术对弈的又一焦点。乌克兰战场出现新变数：波兰因无人机合作争议暂停移交MiG-29，而瑞典正式批准向乌克兰出售“鹰狮”E战斗机，标志着西方军援层级提升。中东方面，美国与以色列对伊朗军事设施实施打击，伊朗宣称反击，局势急剧升级。亚洲方向，中俄在东海、日本海联合轰炸机巡逻，菲律宾则与美国海军陆战队在吕宋海峡演练反舰导弹快速部署，南海紧张态势持续。英国宣布放弃下一代驱逐舰，全面转向无人平台，揭示未来海上作战形态的深刻变革。

- **跨域反舰能力集中展示**：RIMPAC 2026期间，美军将退役的“提康德罗加”级巡洋舰“莫比尔湾”号作为靶船沉没，同时[新西兰空军首次实弹发射“鱼叉”反舰导弹](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxNbG9aYkIwR25HN0Ytb3Q4S1dSRVdaZllrYTh5TDRNWlZ3ZC1OazRsWHpBN1BHeTVieWVTM2o0cTYzS3l0Zng2UUlXVHYyeDU5WjNsUjdoQ2I5RDlIaHFpSDJaV180R2JFeExZblFrTmotWFhVTkExajhVZFB1aEVjeHR6UmFRMVpncUlodHhBSVptQzlnVFNqcWt1elhNa1pLU0xLMk5uODJLZ2s4NHNjRy04bFNFLUVURlVpdTFONFVudGlvcllkR2RHcw)。B-2隐形轰炸机首次披露发射LRASM的能力，直接针对中国反介入/区域拒止体系。
- **欧洲军援转向与内部摩擦**：乌克兰获得[“鹰狮”E战斗机](https://www.twz.com/air/gripen-e-fighters-officially-ordered-by-ukraine)订单，但波兰以“无人机冷落”为由[暂停移交MiG-29](https://www.twz.com/air/mig-29-transfer-to-ukraine-halted-by-poland-over-claimed-drone-snub)，显示盟友协调出现裂痕。拉脱维亚与乌克兰在俄边境共建无人机工厂，[升级对俄前沿威慑](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/06/30/latvia-and-ukraine-to-open-drone-factory-right-on-baltic-nations-border-with-russia/)。
- **中东战火重燃**：美国与以色列对伊朗军事设施实施“定点打击”，伊朗武装部队宣布反击，[“战争回到伊朗”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE4wWU1XcTJjVkhydDJ6REhTa1RGZHp5eHJhYXVpQlRoNndhUjBOamFNWlRERkdMYk53LWc4LVhDbktnSXZ3RkJyWmtEMEgycjRFNmJN)，霍尔木兹海峡航运受威胁，全球能源市场紧张。
- **南海/台海博弈日常化**：美国海军陆战队借用菲律宾民用渡轮，将反舰导弹和防空系统运抵吕宋海峡的卡莱扬岛，[演练“远征前进基地”概念](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/30/u-s-marines-use-commercial-ferries-to-haul-anti-ship-missiles-across-the-philippines)。中国官方媒体发表强硬评论，称要让菲律宾“长长记性”。
- **技术路线颠覆：英国全面拥抱无人平台**：英国防务审查决定放弃新一代驱逐舰，将预算全部投入无人机系统，覆盖陆海空，[被形容为“豪赌”](https://www.twz.com/news-features/uk-sacrifices-its-future-destroyer-as-part-of-massive-bet-on-drones-across-its-forces)。
- **中俄联合空中巡逻常态化**：中俄轰炸机在东海、日本海、西太平洋进行年度首次联合巡航，日韩紧急出动战机监视，[显示战略协作深化](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/30/russia-china-fly-joint-bomber-missions-near-japan-south-korea)。

**后续观察**：未来24小时需重点关注伊朗局势后续升级风险、北约峰会（7月初）对乌克兰军援的新一揽子方案、以及RIMPAC期间更多反舰与反导试验的披露。中国电磁弹射器是否进入舰载测试阶段，将直接影响航母战力生成节奏。
military.en:
The last 24 hours have been marked by significant demonstrations of long-range strike capabilities, escalating geopolitical tensions, and a clear pivot toward unmanned systems across major militaries. The U.S. revealed a new B-2 stealth bomber anti-ship missile capability, while RIMPAC preparations include the sinking of a Ticonderoga-class cruiser. China showcased a truck-mounted electromagnetic aircraft catapult, and the UK announced a radical shift in defense strategy prioritizing drones over a new destroyer. The Middle East saw active strikes between Israel/US and Iran, while the Ukraine war enters a phase of adaptation with new fighter orders and a halted MiG-29 transfer. In the Indo-Pacific, the U.S. Marines demonstrated ferry-based anti-ship missile transport in the Philippines, and Russia-China joint bomber patrols near Japan underscore growing strategic coordination.

- **B-2 Stealth Bomber Reveals Anti-Ship Capability**: The U.S. Air Force confirmed for the first time that the B-2 Spirit can fire the AGM-158C LRASM, a stealthy, long-range anti-ship cruise missile, demonstrated during a Pacific sinking exercise ([Air & Space Forces Magazine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxOeDN0RDlUOEJ4Y3RGb0ladXJRRDdKYTZtOG84TnV5blFkUUVwc0lLM0FtV2lkcGRReC1TLUE5dzhEZjVoR0ptd0JhYWFpYjdaWnVzVmZ5SGtrSTEtUDI4cmVoLVRfRmlEMVEtUkdPLUh1SXBaQk00cEdSLVNNT3dNTzYxU0w), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-pacific-air-forces-flex-b-2-stealth-bomber-lrasm-capability/)). This directly counters Chinese naval expansion and shifts the air-sea battle equation.

- **UK Drops Future Destroyer to Double Down on Drones**: The UK announced it will sacrifice its planned Type 83 destroyer in favor of a massive investment in uncrewed systems across land, sea, and air, placing drones at the center of future force design ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/uk-sacrifices-its-future-destroyer-as-part-of-massive-bet-on-drones-across-its-forces)). This represents the most radical European commitment to drone warfare.

- **China’s Mobile Electromagnetic Catapult Seen in Action**: Video emerged of China’s truck-mounted electromagnetic aircraft catapult system—part of a containerized launch family—operating for the first time, potentially enabling rapid air operations from civilian ships or dispersed land bases ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/chinas-truck-mounted-electromagnetic-aircraft-catapult-seen-in-action-for-the-first-time)).

- **Iran-Israel/US Strikes Escalate**: Reports indicate U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iranian military facilities and Iranian retaliatory actions, with live updates from Dawn ([Dawn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE4wWU1XcTJjVkhydDJ6REhTa1RGZHp5eHJhYXVpQlRoNndhUjBOamFNWlRERkdMYk53LWc4LVhDbktnSXZ3RkJyWmtEMEgycjRFNmJN)). This opens a direct conflict front, raising oil price and Horn of Hormuz risk.

- **Sweden Sends Gripen E Fighters to Ukraine**: Ukraine officially ordered Saab Gripen E fighters, a major leap from Soviet-era aircraft, boosting both air defense and strike capability ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/gripen-e-fighters-officially-ordered-by-ukraine)). Delivery timelines remain unclear.

- **Poland Halts MiG-29 Transfer to Ukraine**: Poland suspended the transfer of 14 additional MiG-29s over a claimed drone snub, highlighting fraying relations between key allies amid war fatigue ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/mig-29-transfer-to-ukraine-halted-by-poland-over-claimed-drone-snub)).

- **U.S. Marines Use Philippine Ferries for Anti-Ship Missile Deployment**: During Exercise Balikatan, the 3rd MLR used commercial ferries to transport anti-ship and air defense systems to Calayan Island near Taiwan, demonstrating a novel, low-signature power projection method ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/30/u-s-marines-use-commercial-ferries-to-haul-anti-ship-missiles-across-the-philippines)).

**Watch next:** The NATO summit in Ankara (July 1-2) will dominate headlines, with Ukraine war escalation, drone cooperation, and the Three Seas Initiative on the agenda. RIMPAC 2026 sink-ex of USS Mobile Bay will test live-fire joint kill chains. Monitor China’s next steps on mobile catapult deployment and any new military exercises near Taiwan.

tech.zh:
今日科技板块的关键词是「震荡」与「破局」。AI领域，Magnificent 7市值因AI支出担忧一日蒸发2.3万亿美元，Michael Burry公开做空特斯拉，市场对AI泡沫的警惕达到新高。与此同时，美国商务部解除对Anthropic最强模型[Claude Fable 5/Mythos 5的出口限制](https://twitter.com/AnthropicAI/status/2072106151890809341)，引发社区激烈辩论。Meta则给自家的智能眼镜加上「软墙」——每月免费额度仅3小时，超出需付20美元订阅费，引发用户反弹。汽车板块，Ferrari首款电动轿车Luce在中国瞬间售罄，证明了超豪华EV的市场潜力；Rivian R2悄然装上激光雷达，形态远优于同类。更引人注目的是，Tesla从Intel挖来17年资深高管负责其Terafab芯片厂，押注自研芯片。

- [Mag 7市值蒸发2.3万亿，AI支出担忧蔓延](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/30/magnificent-7-stocks-sell-off-investors-grow-jittery-on-ai-spending.html) — 市场开始质疑巨额AI投入能否收回，这波抛售可能引发连锁反应。
- [美国商务部解除对Anthropic旗舰模型的出口管制](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48740771) — Anthropic官方宣布Claude Fable 5和Mythos 5即日起可全球出口，社区反响两极，安全和竞争力之间再起争论。
- [Meta智能眼镜推出「速率限制」与软付费墙](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/959899/meta-ai-glasses-paywall-rate-limit) — Conversation Focus功能每月免费仅3小时，订阅费19.99美元/月。硬件已经买了，功能还要付费？用户不买账。
- [Michael Burry披露新空头仓位：做空特斯拉](https://electrek.co/2026/06/30/michael-burry-tesla-short-416/) — Big Short主人公以416.22美元做空TSLA，认为AI和半导体存在泡沫。这为市场情绪添了一把柴。
- [Ferrari Luce EV在中国秒售罄](https://electrek.co/2026/06/30/controversial-ferrari-luce-ev-is-an-instant-sellout-in-china/) — 尽管设计争议不断，但中国市场配额全部订完，说明超豪华EV有真实需求。
- [Tesla从Intel挖来17年老将主导Terafab芯片厂](https://electrek.co/2026/06/30/tesla-intel-veteran-terafab-director/) — Gary Jiang曾任Intel 18A工艺工具安装负责人，特斯拉自研芯片的野心更进一层。
- [Google NotebookLM新增TikTok风格AI视频摘要](https://www.theverge.com/tech/959778/google-notebooklm-ai-clips) — 笔记工具再进化，生成60秒竖屏视频来总结研究资料，但被批评形式大于内容。
- [「互联网之父」Vint Cerf即将从谷歌退休](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/30/the-father-of-the-internet-is-finally-retiring/) — 一个时代标志性人物谢幕，意味着互联网早期精神在大型科技公司中逐步淡出。

**后续观察**：下周需关注Anthropic模型解除限制后实际出口量、特斯拉空头仓位变化、以及Meta订阅模式是否会被其他硬件厂商效仿。市场对AI开支的焦虑可能进一步影响科技股走势。
tech.en:
The tech landscape this Wednesday signals deep uncertainty around AI's economic trajectory, even as regulators loosen restrictions on frontier models. The Magnificent Seven lost $2.3 trillion in market cap as investors question AI spending ROI, while Michael Burry placed a public short against Tesla, calling the sector an 'inflating bubble.' In a countermove, the U.S. Commerce Department lifted export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, enabling a global launch. Meanwhile, the EV market shows bifurcation: Ferrari's controversial Luce EV sold out in China, but Toyota's bZ4X review points to a missing feature, and Tesla poached an Intel veteran for its chip fab. On the community side, a record 500+ point Hacker News thread dissected the export control reversal, while Google released TabFM for tabular data and scientists announced the first early human eggs from stem cells.

- **AI market jitters deep:** The 'Mag 7' lost $2.3 trillion as investors fret over AI capex ROI ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/30/magnificent-7-stocks-sell-off-investors-grow-jittery-on-ai-spending.html)). Michael Burry's new Tesla short at $416 adds to bearish sentiment ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/30/michael-burry-tesla-short-416/)).
- **Regulatory shift lifts frontier AI:** The U.S. Commerce Department lifted export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5, prompting a global rollout and a massive Hacker News debate ([Anthropic tweet](https://twitter.com/AnthropicAI/status/2072106151890809341), [Gulf News](https://news.google.)).
- **Meta monetizes hardware after sale:** Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses now have a $20/month 'Premium' subscription to unlock features like Conversation Focus beyond a 3-hour monthly cap ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/959899/meta-ai-glasses-paywall-rate-limit)).
- **EV market contrasts:** Ferrari's Luce EV sold out instantly in China despite controversy ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/30/controversial-ferrari-luce-ev-is-an-instant-sellout-in-china/)), while Toyota's 2026 bZ review notes one 'big thing missing' ([InsideEVs](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE05d3lSLXZtME1odnE0RktDRmpZSEp3ejFHSzYzZmlEdDZ1dGYwWUw3WUF4X1VueWJnYVcwZjNSejlIcXZaTU44a0dCWWs3WUx2a2U5eDF4azM0cHlmVkMwVE85TDdLZUFfZ253)).
- **Scientific breakthroughs hit the front page:** The first early human eggs from stem cells were announced ([Conception.bio](https://www.conception.bio/science-and-updates/the-first-early-human-eggs-from-stem-cells)), and Google's TabFM offers zero-shot tabular ML ([Google Research](https://research.google/blog/introducing-tabfm-a-zero-shot-foundation-model-for-tabular-data/)).
- **Tech industry veterans move:** Vint Cerf, 'Father of the Internet,' is retiring from Google ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/30/the-father-of-the-internet-is-finally-retiring/)), and Dish filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/959894/dish-chapter-11-bankruptcy)).

**Watch next:** All eyes are on the market sell-off's ripple effects: if AI spending cuts begin, it could chill VC funding and startup valuations. The Claude Fable 5 global release may accelerate enterprise adoption, but the subscriptionification of hardware (Meta glasses) could set a precedent for other IoT devices. In EVs, watch for whether Ferrari's sellout signals real demand or hype. Tomorrow, the July 4 holiday will likely mute trading volume, making any moves more volatile.

sports.zh: 2026年7月1日，世界杯淘汰赛即将全面打响，墨西哥在阿兹特克球场势不可挡，2-0完胜厄瓜多尔后挺进16强，有可能与英格兰上演巅峰对决。英格兰方面，图赫尔确认沿袭索斯盖特留下的点球计划，但右后卫夸安萨和里斯·詹姆斯因伤缺阵，为迎战刚果（金）埋下隐患。法国队3-0轻取瑞典，姆巴佩梅开二度成为世界杯淘汰赛历史最佳射手，高卢雄鸡气势如虹。荷兰队出局后主帅科曼辞职，球员遭遇种族歧视，引发舆论哗然。羽毛球赛场，新加坡公开赛出现争议判罚，乐蒂组合申诉无效但强势翻盘；马来西亚公开赛半决赛石宇奇激战安赛龙。CBA方面，郭士强在热身赛中“抢断”日本球引发热议，媒体披露国家队奥运激励条款——冲进前八每人奖励30万元。虎扑社区里，皇马球迷盛赞“睡衣哥”，基恩对卡塞米罗的评价遭遇“打脸”，马刺补强前锋目标锁定八村塁等人。后续观察：今晚英格兰对阵刚果（金）将是关键考验，墨西哥的强势主场能否延续？羽毛球新加坡站明日进入决赛日，冷门可能继续发酵。
sports.en:
The World Cup knockout rounds are taking shape, with Mexico and France delivering dominant performances while England faces injury setbacks and a potential clash with the hosts. Off the pitch, a Dutch coaching resignation and racist abuse scandal shake the tournament. In other sports, basketball sees CBA incentive policies and a heated fan debate, while badminton tournaments continue in Asia. The Chinese fan community on Hupu buzzes with transfer rumors, historic rivalries, and player stats.

- **Mexico's fortress Azteca**: Mexico cruised past 10-man Ecuador 2-0 to win all four group games without conceding, setting up a last-16 tie against the winner of England vs DR Congo. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/c2ky840z4wqo) | [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/mexico-vs-ecuador/report/549842)
- **France unstoppable**: Kylian Mbappé scored twice to become the all-time leading goalscorer in World Cup knockout matches as France beat Sweden 3-0, advancing to face Paraguay. Deschamps urges caution despite the brilliance. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cp8r1zdj9k5o) | [BBC Video](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/c6216q7d62ro)
- **England's right-back crisis**: Jarell Quansah and Reece James ruled out of the DR Congo match, leaving Tuchel to shuffle his defense. Tuchel confirms he will stick to Southgate's penalty shootout plan. - **Koeman resigns amid racist abuse**: Netherlands manager Ronald Koeman stepped down after World Cup exit, which triggered racist abuse toward players who missed penalties. The Dutch federation reports the incidents. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cly0g1y3v00o)
- **Haaland's staggering projection**: Erling Haaland's international goal tally could reach 260 if current trajectory holds, following his big-stage performance for Norway. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cvge3wkn1v7o)
